description: Enhanced coverage for compressed log-batch decoding (disjoint from native case). Freshly generated gzip+base64 payloads exercise: multiple subscription filters rendered as a comma-separated list with a single CONTROL_MESSAGE event; an empty batch with zero filters and zero events (empty subscriptionFilters line, events=0, no entry lines); and a three-event batch whose messages contain commas, semicolons and equals signs to confirm raw message text is reported verbatim.
